description: Find individual request traces (30 per call unless "limit" asks for up to 100; newest first unless sortBy is set) with response time, memory, bottlenecks and the slowest layers. Use to investigate specific slow or failing requests; filter by transaction IDs from tideways_get_performance, text, time window and response time.

detail.description: "concise" (default) returns a trimmed summary. "full" also includes the unmodified API response under "raw"; it can be very large.

environment.description: Environment, e.g. "production" or "staging". Defaults to the configured environment, else production; criteria.environment (traces: each trace's environment) shows which was used. When results come back, an unknown name fails with an error.

from.description: Earliest trace time, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm" UTC; needs "to" as well

limit.description: Traces to return, up to 100. Raise it to cover a busy window or to find rarer examples, such as traces with an nplus1 bottleneck.

project.description: Tideways project as "project" or "organization/project". Defaults to the defaultProject that tideways_list_projects reports; call it for valid names.

search.description: One whole word from the transaction name or URL path (e.g. "checkout"), matched against transaction, host and URL tokens. Several words match any of them and widen the result.

service.description: Service, e.g. "web" or "worker". Defaults to the configured service, else the project's default service. A project can have several services; tideways_list_services lists them. When results come back, an unknown name fails with an error.

sortBy.description: response_time = slowest first, memory = highest first; omit for newest first. Without from/to, sorted results span all retained traces (~30 days).

to.description: Latest trace time (inclusive), "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm" UTC; needs "from" as well

transactionIds.description: Only traces of these transactions: numeric IDs from transactions[].id of tideways_get_performance. Combines with search, environment, service, sortBy and the from/to window.

withCallgraph.description: true = only traces that have a full callgraph (profile)

name: tideways_search_traces

limitReached.description: True when as many traces came back as "limit" asked for: raise "limit" (up to 100), narrow the time window or change sortBy to see others

raw.description: Unmodified Tideways API response; present only when detail is "full".

bottlenecks.description: Bottlenecks Tideways detected in this trace, e.g. "nplus1" (N+1 queries or calls; the observation bottleneck-nplus1), "wait", "sql", "http". There is no filter for them.

link.description: Trace page in the Tideways UI

topLayers.description: Layers with the largest share of the response time

title: Search traces
